1879048830.name: an unarmed attack
1879048830.desc: Auto-attack when not wielding a weapon in the primary hand.

1879052286.name: Wild Peck
1879052286.desc: Your companion makes a wild and damaging attack.

1879064190.name: Perfect Ballad
1879064190.desc: Heals you and harms your foe.\n\nBallads unlock Anthems and Codas.

1879089790.name: Dúnadan's Strike
1879089790.desc: A Ranger is both master of blade and bow. This attack will knock down the opponent.

1879157630.name: Bold Arrow
1879157630.desc: A slef buff that increases critical hit chance and damage.

1879198334.name: Friend of Noble Birds (Ashen-eagle)
1879198334.desc: Summons an eagle companion.\n\nThe eagle is a noble creature which can deal damage and, if called upon, will sacrifice itself to save you.

1879214590.name: Dance of War
1879214590.desc: A manoeuvre designed to evade enemy blows.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879215870.name: To Arms (Blade-brother)
1879215870.desc: Briefly increases the offence of your Blade-brother.

1879233022.name: Shield and Javelin
1879233022.desc: Capable Wardens prepare their shield and javelin for attack.

1879240702.name: Sundering Blow
1879240702.desc: A violent attack that deals damage to the target while healing the champion. \n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879244414.name: Ranged Resounding Challenge
1879244414.desc: Your challenge echoes in the ears of your foes.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879248382.name: Seeking Arrow - Light
1879248382.desc: Steadying your mount, you attempt a well-placed shot at an enemy that will deal Light-based damage and apply a potentially harmful effect to your target.

1879272830.name: Improved Sure Strike
1879272830.desc: An attack that cannot be blocked or parried.\n\nReduces the active cooldown of Battle-shout.

1879319934.name: Bolstering Cry
1879319934.desc: Crying out, you encourage your steed to continue the fight and restore a moderate amount of its endurance in the process.

1879324030.name: Brown Squirrel
1879324030.desc: Summons a squirrel to keep you company.

1879329150.name: Return to Minas Tirith
1879329150.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Defenders of Minas Tirith, you're able to quickly return to the gate of Minas Tirith. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879334654.name: Westernesse Stab
1879334654.desc: A quick stab with the blade of Westernesse can inflict great harm to your foes.

1879341438.name: Winter Dove Kite
1879341438.desc: Brings out a winter dove kite for you to fly!

1879360382.name: Steed of Eldar Autumn
1879360382.desc: A pony from the Fall Festival.

1879415550.name: Extremely Subtle Portent of Deftness
1879415550.desc: A quick burst of defence, absorbing a portion of damage dealt to you.

1879440126.name: Gundabad Vanquisher Steed
1879440126.desc: A steed as mysterious and wild as Mount Gundabad

1879466238.name: Re-centre
1879466238.desc: After using a Finisher skill, recentre yourself and regain your balance.

1879467262.name: Call the Banners of War
1879467262.desc: Sing a shanty of the banners of war, rippling in the azure sky and inspiring your allies.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This effect does not stack with a Captain's Standard of War Damage buff.</rgb>

1879470590.name: Discipline: Riddermark
1879470590.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat

<rgb=#66ffff>Riddermark</rgb>

The Riddermark Discipline focuses on distraction and placing enemies in the way of danger.

1879475966.name: Journey to the Order of the Eagle
1879475966.desc: Journey to Order of the Eagle Allegiance members in the Lower Ward in Umbar Baharbêl.

1879489150.name: Hardened Hide
1879489150.desc: Your companion shrugs off attacks for a brief period.

1879494910.name: Scorpion Surprise Bauble
1879494910.desc: Place down a surprisingly realistic scorpion to startle your friends.

1879508606.name: Blood Scorpion
1879508606.desc: Summons a fearsome blood scorpion to accompany you on your travels.

1879509118.name: Handful of Bird Feed
1879509118.desc: Toss out some delicious bird feed, sure to attract some feathered friends!

1879523198.name: The Effigy of The Bane of Rhûn
1879523198.desc: Summon an effigy of The Bane of Rhûn, doomed to die shortly after it appears.

1879525374.name: Yellow Star Fireworks
1879525374.desc: Set off some festive star-shaped fireworks!

1879526910.name: Steal Breath
1879526910.desc: You reach out and steal your enemy's breath, interrupting inductions.
